text:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a rolling maintenance window for AZ3 this Wednesday 02:00-04:00 UTC. We need to reboot two edge switches and then perform a staged node reboot on the nearby GPU rack. Expect brief pod evictions and slow KV-cache warmups.

<todd>: ETA on user-facing impact? which pools? :eyes:

<maria>: Primary impact on gpu-pool-az3-saturn (non-preemptible) and burst-pool-az3. We plan to cordon one rack at a time, drain, reboot BMC + NIC, then uncordon. Targeted ~20min per rack. Typical token throughput drop ~10-15% during handoff.

<cheng>: Plan looks fine. Can we keep a canary rack warm to absorb qps? Also request we disable autoscaler scale-down during window.

<maria>: Yes, will pin canary: rack-az3-c1 stays active. Disabling scale-down with: `kubectl annotate hpa --all scale-down.disabled=true` (we'll remove after).

<lisa>: Ops question — any cross-region fallback for Dedicated tenants? Customers in EU might route to eu-west variant automatically but some latency jump. Need to call SRE for high-SLA tenants.

<maria>: Good call. Sam, can you add a temporary routing rule for two priority tenants to prefer eu-west on failover?

<sam>: On it. I'll push a route pref with lower weight for az3-hosted -> eu-west-hosted for tenant ids T-142, T-879. Doing a dry-run now and will post logs.

<ops-bot>: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance created — ID mnt-az3-2026-02-02-02. Notifications sent to priority tenant owners.

<todd>: Cost note — if we spill load cross-region, estimated egress add-on ~$120/hr during window (per our rate card). Finance flagged this for recurring windows.

<maria>: Noted. We'll aim for single-window and avoid multi-day re-routes. If the egress delta exceeds $250 for the job, abort and reschedule.

<cheng>: Two ops items: 1) ensure KV cache seeding script runs after each uncordon: `./scripts/prime_kv.sh rack-az3-<id>` 2) post-check: `curl -s http://metrics/internal/latency | jq .az3` — ensure median token latency within 10% baseline.

<maria>: Added post-check steps to runbook. I'll paste the runbook in #runbooks after final review.

<lisa>: I'll warn affected customers in support with the planned window and expected latency bump. Template: short, concrete numbers, and contact path to SRE.

<sam>: Dry-run of route change succeeded. Logs: ```
INFO 2026-02-01 18:40: route pref set for T-142 -> eu-west-hosted (weight 0.2)
INFO 2026-02-01 18:40: route pref set for T-879 -> eu-west-hosted (weight 0.2)
```

<maria>: Thanks. Final ask: ops on-call please ack and be present during the window for 02:00-04:00 UTC. If anything deviates, escalate to #eng-sre and page SRE lead. :thumbsup:

<ops-bot>: oncall-bot: @cheng assigned for on-call for this window.

<cheng>: Acked. Will be monitoring kv hit rates and tail latency dashboards.

<todd>: LGTM. Small nit — add backoff for autoscaler removal: `sleep 60` between undrain steps to avoid micro-probing.

<maria>: Will include. Thanks everyone. I'll post the runbook link and the final tenant notification before EOD.
